newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Commercial rises on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Commercial rises on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Bank Ltd rose 2.84 percent, or four rupees, to 145 on Wednesday on expectations the bank will likely benefit from an improvement in the economy, brokers said.
"Banks are expected to play a major role in the economic recovery expected in 1997," said a local broker. Volume in the bank was around 2,100 shares.
Economic growth, which slowed in 1996 due to a drought and power cuts, is expected to improve in 1997.
Commercial Bank is one of four private commercial banks listed in Colombo. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
